scripts.build: npm run build -w @infra/core && npm run build -w @infra/server && npm run build -w @infra/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @infra/core && npm run typecheck -w @infra/server && npm run typecheck -w @infra/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @infra/core && concurrently -n core,server,web "npm run dev -w @infra/core" "npm run dev -w @infra/server" "npm run dev -w @infra/web"
